name: Nami — Art of Weather
description: Stationary Straw Hat weather controller, manga continuity through Wano. Implements Clima-Tact lightning, scheduled Heat Egg projectiles, Gust Sword displacement and Raitei. Zeus already resides in the Clima-Tact at placement: Hera seemingly consumes his former body, the weapon speaks, and his survival within it is explained during Wano. No former standalone Zeus body is summoned. A generous lightning collision radius and optional prelaunch retargeting approximate his assistance; true homing, weapon reshaping and consciousness transfer are omitted. Mirage Tempo and Fata Morgana are omitted optical deception: this encounter has no defensive targeting or evasion, so they grant no fake damage, concealment detection or taunt. Milky Road terrain/travel, showers, Impact Dial absorption/recoil, navigation, theft and financial management are also omitted. Heat/cool preparation is compressed into attack setup. Thunderbolt Tempo's 20% slow for 1.8 seconds and Raitei's 20% slow for 3 seconds are added game-only crowd-control adaptations, not effects established by the supplied through-Wano evidence or inferred from lightning damage. Both require positive damage and slowable targets and refresh without stacking magnitude. Purchased primary stuns are likewise game-only additions, not sourced Wano feats; later-arc feats are excluded. No regeneration denial, healing, ally damage buffs or elemental immunity bypass. All numbers, prices, stamina costs, schedules and tier unlocks are provisional game adaptations, not canon measurements or measured balance. Stamina represents Technique preparation, not transformation exhaustion. The highest purchased tier on any path unlocks Gust Sword at 1 and Raitei at 5. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique in the current form is exposed through one shared button; Raitei replaces Gust Sword, with no separate permanent lower-tier buttons. Purchases are cumulative under the host's maximum 5-2-0 rule. Enemy movement remains caller-supplied. Other unsupported powers remain omitted rather than inferred.

paths.name: Thundercloud Output
paths.description: Personal lightning and Technique damage specialization. Heat Egg remains a separate, static scheduled attack and receives none of these purchases. Damage scaling is authored tuning, not a new power or a claim that Raitei defeats every opponent in one hit. The highest unlocked contextual Technique in the current form is the only Technique exposed; lower-tier Techniques are not separate permanent buttons.

upgrades.name: Charged Weather Balls
upgrades.description: Adds 4 damage to the primary and all Techniques. Highest tier 1 also unlocks stamina and Gust Sword.

upgrades.name: Denser Thundercloud
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by 1.2 after flat additions.

upgrades.name: Larger Charge Reserve
upgrades.description: Adds another 8 damage to the primary and all Techniques; does not change or refill stamina.

upgrades.name: Concentrated Discharge
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by a further 1.3.

upgrades.name: Zeus-Amplified Thunder
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by a further 1.45. Highest tier 5 replaces Gust Sword with Raitei; Zeus was already present in the weapon.

paths.name: Weather Preparation
paths.description: Improves personal weather setup and adds game-only primary lightning interruption. Timing reductions represent practiced Clima-Tact preparation, not navigation-based speed magic. The purchased contact stuns are authored crowd-control additions: the supplied through-Wano evidence establishes lightning attacks, not these timed stuns. No later-arc stun feat is used to justify them. Their electrical names are gameplay flavor, not additional canonical techniques. Stuns require both weakWilled and stunnable, respecting active stun and the following protection interval. No purchase improves scheduled Heat Egg. The highest unlocked contextual Technique is the sole shared Technique button.

upgrades.name: Prepared Heat and Cool Mix
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by 0.9. Technique timing is unchanged.

upgrades.name: Brief Electrical Interruption
upgrades.description: Adds a game-only 0.35-second stun to eligible primary contacts, not a stun established by through-Wano evidence. Requires weakWilled and stunnable; resistant or protected targets are not stunned.

upgrades.name: Efficient Cloud Assembly
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by a further 0.85; does not accelerate Techniques or Heat Egg.

upgrades.name: Sustained Electrical Interruption
upgrades.description: Raises the game-only eligible primary contact stun from 0.35 to 0.75 seconds, rather than adding durations. This is authored control tuning, not a sourced Wano power; weakWilled, stunnable and stun-protection checks remain unchanged.

upgrades.name: Weatheria Setup Mastery
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary timing by a further 0.8 and raises the game-only eligible contact stun to 1 second. The stun is not established by through-Wano evidence and retains weakWilled, stunnable and protection checks. Tier 5 supplies Raitei through the shared Technique button, replacing Gust Sword rather than adding another button.

paths.name: Cloud Placement
paths.description: Extends personal acquisition reach and improves prelaunch target handling. Reach is an abstract deployment limit for localized weather, not staff length. Zeus-assisted retargeting replaces one lost primary target only before launch; projectiles never home or retarget after launch, and Techniques never retarget. Mirage Tempo is deliberately not repurposed as detection. The highest unlocked contextual Technique remains the only Technique button.

upgrades.name: Extended Cloud Placement
upgrades.description: Adds 4 personal reach, taking the unmodified base reach from 40 to 44.

upgrades.name: Zeus Checks the Target
upgrades.description: Enables one replacement for a lost primary target before launch without restarting windup. No postlaunch steering or Technique retargeting.

upgrades.name: Distant Cloud Positioning
upgrades.description: Adds another 6 personal reach, reaching 50 on this path. Does not change Heat Egg range or projectile speed.

upgrades.name: Stable Long-Range Discharge
upgrades.description: Adds 5 personal reach and 5 damage to the primary and all Techniques.

upgrades.name: Far-Reaching Thundercloud
upgrades.description: Adds 5 personal reach, reaching 60 on this path, and multiplies primary and all Technique damage by 1.25. Tier 5 supplies Raitei; its larger collision tolerance remains an aimed-shot adaptation.
